card.name: Linking words in seafood cooking text
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, and, the, a nice) in food and cooking text, mostly about fish, crab, lobster and salmon, right before the next food or cooking word.

card.writes: It suppresses forms of the word preserve, so it steers away from preservation wording in food text.
card.plain: It fires on little connecting words in cooking and seafood writing, where the next word is unlikely to be about preserving.
